description: Reverse-engineering all distance-structured patterns from Papers 1-2 into the operational TEP clock kernel. Each family is tested with the same leakage-free nested-CV as step_25, with hyperparameters selected on training LOO.
method: nested CV: (λ, nugget, K, form, aniso_mode, aniso_ratio) selected by LOO inside TRAIN, scored on held-out TEST
headline: Kernel family comparison: baseline (exponential, isotropic) achieves 42.3% skill vs raw. Best family: exponential with 42.3% skill (+0.0 pp vs baseline). Selected λ*=4200 km, nugget=0.05, K=15.
